relationship_to_v1: FRESH preregistration, not an amendment. `preregistration.json` in this directory described the previous backend; its execution conditions are now false. It is retained unedited as the record of the halted attempt. v2 supersedes it for execution and inherits nothing implicitly.

trials_completed_under_v1.skill-1: VOID twice over: killed mid-loop by the halt (not by the model, the server, or its own timeout), and subsequently established to have kept running against the swapped backend for ~12 minutes after I wrongly reported it stopped. Not a trial outcome, not analysed, outside every count.
trials_completed_under_v1.bring_up_probes: 3, harness checks only, never trials. See BRINGUP.md.

the_condition.quantization: explicitly 4-bit. The previous default id `qwen3.8-27b-mlx` stated no quantization, so whether these are the same weights is unanswerable and is not assumed either way.
the_condition.reasoning: server-set low. Operator measurement: 2,942 characters of thinking plus 6,554 of body, against roughly 10,000 / 0 before.
the_condition.enable_thinking_override: chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": true} exists and is NOT used. Using it would be a separate preregistered condition.
the_condition.throughput: code decode 28.7 -> 36.4 tok/s; output content reported unaffected; 32k prefill 102.9 s cold, 0.147 s on a cache hit
the_condition.concurrency_guidance: The server now batches up to 2 and queues 3+, with under 3% measured difference at 3 concurrent, so sequential is no longer required. This experiment runs sequentially anyway: the measured gain is nil, and single-flight keeps wall-clock -- which is a recorded outcome here -- free of contention from a neighbouring trial.

not_poolable.statement: Results from this experiment MUST NOT be pooled with, compared as if the condition were constant against, or used to revise: m7-head-local-v1 in its entirety, m8-impl-local-v1 task 1 (all four cells), m8-impl-local-v1 task 2 (n=1 per arm), or the m8 task-2 replication (10 trials). Nor the reverse.
reasons: Different serving implementation, and a different advertised model with explicitly 4-bit quantization where the previous default stated none.
Reasoning behaviour changed at the server.
Speculative decoding is now in the path.

Transport: those experiments cannot even be re-executed. /v1/responses returns 404 on this backend and Codex 0.147 dropped wire_api = "chat", so every m7- and m8-style local harness is unrunnable as written, independent of the weights question.

confound_named_up_front.statement: A better result here is NOT evidence that the methodology transfers.
confound_named_up_front.why: The dominant failure mode of every prior series in this program was reasoning that never terminated -- m7's bare arm burned 65,535 of 65,536 output tokens on thinking and emitted nothing, and 2 of 9 review units ended in silent truncation. This backend sets reasoning effort low, which removes that failure mode AT THE SERVER, for both arms, before the methodology does anything.
confound_named_up_front.consequence: Any improvement over m8 is attributable to the condition at least as readily as to the method, and this design cannot separate them. It is not a comparison against m8 and will not be reported as one.
confound_named_up_front.what_can_still_be_learned: Whether qwen is usable for implementation work in a realistic agentic setting under the CURRENT condition, and what the loop actually does. That is a within-condition question and is unaffected.

question: Unchanged from v1: is qwen usable for implementation work when given a shell, a compiler, a test suite, and as many turns as it takes? This is a practical-usability question with correspondingly weak attribution, NOT m8's controlled question about whether the methodology has an effect. The arm names `skill` and `noskill` must not be read as reviving the old question.

scripts/halt.sh added: kills recorded process groups by id, sweeps survivors by binary path, never pattern-matches inline argv, and verifies by an untruncated COUNT that makes it exit non-zero if anything survives.
scripts/check_backend_identity.py added and run before every trial: gates on the /v1/models identity hash.
run_series.sh now RECORDS the echoed model id instead of gating on it.

backend_identity_gate.replaces: asserting on response.model, which passed through an entire backend swap because this server echoes whatever id the request sent
backend_identity_gate.principle: The echoed field is the server's Claim about itself. The listing is an observation that has already, once, detected a real change.
backend_identity_gate.enforcement: run_trial.sh refuses to start a trial if the gate fails (exit 66); run_series.sh stops the series. Tested positive and negative before freezing.
backend_identity_gate.honest_ceiling: This proves the advertised listing is unchanged. No endpoint here attests loaded weights, so it is a falsifiable check, not proof of model identity.

arms.manipulated_variable: one paragraph naming the skill, plus the skill file present in the checkout; mechanically verified as the only prompt delta

primary_output_is_descriptive.statement: Per-trial records: the three verdicts plus what the loop actually did. NOT an arm comparison.
primary_output_is_descriptive.comparative_claims: Nothing is ever ACCEPTED. Complete separation (3/3 versus 0/3) on a verdict axis is reported as SUGGESTIVE only. Anything less is noise, stated in advance. m8 at n=5 with far tighter control accepted nothing in either direction; this has less power, more variance, and a named confound.

half_edited_tree_rule.rule: How the loop ended is classified BEFORE its code is looked at, and that classification wins. exit 124 -> loop_incomplete_timeout; other non-zero -> loop_incomplete_error. A half-edited tree that does not compile is reported as loop_incomplete_*, never as does_not_compile. Such trials are excluded from compiles/tests_pass tallies and the exclusion is reported with its count.
half_edited_tree_rule.distinct_from: no_change_made, which is a cleanly terminated loop that left the target file byte-identical to the pinned revision

isolation.per_trial_cargo_target_dir: mandatory -- m8 AMENDMENT-005 demonstrated a shared one serving another tree's library and producing wrong measurements, and an agentic loop runs cargo far more often
isolation.real_repository_invisible: --tmpfs over /home/rizumita/workspace inside the sandbox, so the acceptance test and every prior result are unreachable
isolation.benchmarks_removed: the pinned archive carries benchmarks/m7-head-local-v1; it is deleted from every working copy
isolation.acceptance_test_never_in_the_agent_tree: installed only by the verifier, into a fresh tree built from the pinned revision into which only rust.rs is copied, so test-gaming is mechanically impossible and every discarded out-of-scope edit is still recorded
isolation.credentials: fresh mode-700 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR per trial, no credentials inside, dummy API key

known_bug_watch.symptom: response tails cut unnaturally -- a sentence ending mid-way, a code block left unclosed. Backend-specific, upstream unfixed, locally patched, and the patch can be lost on a package update.
known_bug_watch.correspondence_recorded_not_asserted: Symptomatically matches the upstream_silent_truncation class this program defined on LM Studio, and Ollama produced its own variant. Three serving implementations, same weights family, truncated-or-absent tails. No common cause is asserted; the correspondence is on file so that root-causing one puts the others up for re-check.
known_bug_watch.handling: If a trial's output ends mid-sentence or with an unclosed block, that is recorded on the trial and the series STOPS. No retry. Record the time noticed, the approximate token count, and the client.

stopping_rules: One request in flight at any time.
No retry of any trial, for any reason.
Any upstream failure stops the series immediately; the next trial is not started. Record time, approximate token count, client, and how many trials of each arm completed.
A backend identity gate failure stops the series.
A truncated-tail symptom stops the series.
Per-trial wall-clock cap 5,400 s, enforced by `timeout`; hitting it is loop_incomplete_timeout and does not by itself stop the series.
Maximum 6 trials. A trial lost upstream is excluded and NOT replaced -- a replacement chosen after seeing which trials survived is selection.
Every halt uses scripts/halt.sh, whose verification is an untruncated count and which exits non-zero if anything survives. No halt is reported as successful on any other basis.
judging: Same protocol as m8: content-addressed change ids, hash-ordered, identical changes collapse, abort-not-redact marker scan, --no-session-persistence --tools "", cross-family, reference solution never shown, one call per distinct change.
preservation: Each trial is copied into the repository as it completes, never batched.

condition_clarification_added_post_freez.added: 2026-08-19 evening, after trial 1, at the coordinator's request
condition_clarification_added_post_freez.why_this_is_not_a_criteria_change: It states a fact about the condition that was already true and already implied by run_trial.sh. It changes no arm, no verdict, no threshold and no stopping rule.
condition_clarification_added_post_freez.reasoning_is_not_an_experimental_variabl: m9 does not specify reasoning AT ALL. There is no reasoning_effort and no chat_template_kwargs anywhere in run_trial.sh, and Claude Code offers no path to send either. Reasoning is fixed at the server's default `low`, identically for both arms.
condition_clarification_added_post_freez.consequence: The operator's enable_thinking: true override CANNOT be tested within this design. Doing so needs a client that can set chat_template_kwargs, which this one cannot, and would be a separate preregistered condition.
condition_clarification_added_post_freez.relation_to_the_named_confound: This is the mechanism behind the confound already named in `confound_named_up_front`: reasoning terminating is a property of the server, applied identically to both arms, that neither arm can influence.
condition_clarification_added_post_freez.corroborated_by_measurement: skill-1's authoritative usage reports output_tokens_details.thinking_tokens = 0, and the backend's per-turn usage carries no reasoning key at all, so reasoning volume is not even observable from this client.
